name: Blue Mango
summary: Blue Mango is a flagship DTF breeding project built from Somango XXL and Blueberry Butcher.
selectionFocus: Preserve vigorous plant growth and strong lateral branching
Select toward the documented candy-blueberry and ripe-mango aromatic direction
